```{r}
#| label: libs

install.packages(c("httr", "jsonlite", "dplyr", "purrr", "tidyr"))
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
#| label: pull function

get_fpl <- function(endpoint) {
  url <- paste0("https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/", endpoint)
  res <- GET(url, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0"))  # some setups need a UA header
  stop_for_status(res)
  fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: players data

############## GENERAL INFORMATION ###########
bootstrap = get_fpl("bootstrap-static/")
players = bootstrap$elements

players_df <- players %>%
  select(
    id, first_name, second_name, web_name, team, element_type,
    now_cost,total_points,  points_per_game, transfers_in, transfers_out,
    minutes, goals_scored, assists, clean_sheets, goals_conceded,
    own_goals, penalties_saved, penalties_missed, yellow_cards, red_cards,
    saves, bonus, bps, influence, creativity, threat, ict_index,
    clearances_blocks_interceptions, recoveries, tackles,
    defensive_contribution, starts,
    expected_goals, expected_assists, expected_goal_involvements,
    expected_goals_conceded,
    expected_goals_per_90, expected_assists_per_90,
    expected_goal_involvements_per_90, expected_goals_conceded_per_90,
    saves_per_90, goals_conceded_per_90, starts_per_90, clean_sheets_per_90,
    defensive_contribution_per_90,
    influence_rank, creativity_rank, threat)

players_df <- players_df %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(expected_goals, expected_assists, expected_goal_involvements,
      expected_goals_conceded, influence, creativity, threat, ict_index,
      expected_goals_per_90, expected_assists_per_90,
      expected_goal_involvements_per_90, expected_goals_conceded_per_90,
      saves_per_90, goals_conceded_per_90, starts_per_90, clean_sheets_per_90,
      defensive_contribution_per_90),
    as.numeric
  ))

# JOIN POSITIONS AND TEAM
teams     <- bootstrap$teams
positions <- bootstrap$element_types


players_df <- players_df %>%
  left_join(teams %>% select(id, team_name = name, team_short = short_name), 
            by = c("team" = "id")) %>%
  left_join(positions %>% select(id, position = singular_name, position_short = singular_name_short), 
            by = c("element_type" = "id")) %>%
  relocate(team_name, team_short, position, position_short, .after = second_name)
```

```{r}
############## FIXTURES ###########
fixtures = get_fpl("fixtures/")
events   <- bootstrap$events

current_gw <- events %>% filter(is_current == TRUE) %>% pull(id)
# if between gameweeks / preseason, fall back to next one
if (length(current_gw) == 0) current_gw <- events %>% filter(is_next == TRUE) %>% pull(id)

fixtures_long <- bind_rows(
  fixtures %>%
    transmute(event, team = team_h, opponent = team_a,
              difficulty = team_h_difficulty, is_home = TRUE),
  fixtures %>%
    transmute(event, team = team_a, opponent = team_h,
              difficulty = team_a_difficulty, is_home = FALSE)
) %>%
  left_join(teams %>% select(id, opponent_name = name), by = c("opponent" = "id")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(event)) %>%   # drops fixtures not yet scheduled to a GW
  arrange(team, event)

next5 <- fixtures_long %>%
  filter(event >= current_gw, event < current_gw + 5) %>%
  group_by(team) %>%
  summarise(
    fdr_next5 = round(mean(difficulty), 2),
    fixtures_next5 = paste0(opponent_name, " (", ifelse(is_home, "H", "A"), ")", collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

next10 <- fixtures_long %>%
  filter(event >= current_gw, event < current_gw + 10) %>%
  group_by(team) %>%
  summarise(
    fdr_next10 = round(mean(difficulty), 2),
    fixtures_next10 = paste0(opponent_name, " (", ifelse(is_home, "H", "A"), ")", collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

players_df <- players_df %>%
  left_join(next5, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(next10, by = "team")
```

# ALL-INDEX

```{r}
players_df = players_df %>% 
  mutate(allindex = scale(total_points) * scale(minutes) * scale(now_cost) * scale(ict_index))
```

```{r}
############## FIXTURES BY GAMEWEEK ###########
bootstrap = get_fpl("bootstrap-static/")

############## DATA ON PLAYERS ###########
players = get_fpl("element-summary/")
```

# FORWARDS

```{r}
forwards = players_df %>% 
  filter(position_short == "FWD", web_name != "Haaland") %>% 
  select(web_name, total_points,minutes, goals_scored,expected_goals,assists, expected_assists,yellow_cards,bonus,ict_index, now_cost, fdr_next5, fdr_next10)

forwards_df = forwards %>% select(-web_name) %>% scale() %>% as.data.frame()
fwd_lm = lm(total_points ~ minutes + expected_goals + expected_assists + yellow_cards, data = forwards_df)

forwards$quality_score <- predict(fwd_lm)

forwards = forwards %>% 
  filter(quality_score > 0)
ggplot(data = forwards, aes(x = fdr_next10, y = quality_score, label = web_name, colour = now_cost, size = minutes)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "green", high = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Fixture Difficulty (Next 5 GWs)",
    y = "Quality Score",
    colour = "Price (£0.1m)",
    title = "Forwards: Fixture Difficulty vs Quality Score"
  )
```

# MIDFIELDERS

```{r}
mid_lm = lm(total_points ~ minutes + expected_goals + expected_assists + defensive_contribution + expected_goals_conceded, data = mids_df)
```

# DEFENDERS

```{r}
defenders = players_df %>% 
  filter(position_short == "DEF")  %>% 
  select(web_name, total_points, minutes, goals_scored, expected_goals,assists, expected_assists,defensive_contribution,goals_conceded ,expected_goals_conceded, ,yellow_cards, now_cost, fdr_next5, fdr_next10)

def_df = defenders %>% select(-web_name) %>% scale() %>% as.data.frame()
def_lm = lm(total_points ~ minutes + expected_goals + expected_assists + defensive_contribution + expected_goals_conceded, data = def_df)

defenders$quality_score <- predict(def_lm)

defenders = defenders %>% 
  filter(quality_score > 0)
ggplot(data = defenders, aes(x = fdr_next10, y = quality_score, label = web_name, colour = now_cost, size = minutes)) +
  geom_point() +

    x = "Fixture Difficulty (Next 5 GWs)",

  )
```
